name: 波鲁纳雷夫

idle.desc: Polnareff standing, breathing bob (2f); tall silver flat-top

walk.desc: Polnareff walk: contact, pass, contact, pass (4f)

crawl.desc: Polnareff on all fours, grimacing (humiliation gag), 2f crawl step (50x34)

fight.desc: fencing stance: lunge, finger pointing forward, back arm arced (2f)

wave.desc: bonus: happy goodbye wave, eyes closed grin (2f)

shock.desc: shocked: hands on cheeks, mouth agape, hair jumps (2f jitter)

down.desc: knocked down on his back, head LEFT, eyes shut (60x22); anchor = ground

portrait.desc: Polnareff bust: silver flat-top, black brows, blue eyes; f0 closed f1 talking

portrait_shock.desc: Polnareff shocked: bulging eyes, jaw dropped, sweat (2f)

expressions.desc: Polnareff bust: silver flat-top, black brows, blue eyes; f0 closed f1 talking
Polnareff shocked: bulging eyes, jaw dropped, sweat (2f)

source.call: game.sea_half_head（import assets; assets.load_all(); from engine import sprite; sprite.get('polnareff.<动作>').frames）；原引擎绘制：engine.sprite.draw(img, 'polnareff.<动作>', x, y, frame=i, flip=False)

notes: 波鲁纳雷夫（Jean Pierre Polnareff），主角团·人物。朝向：所有帧默认朝右；朝左请水平翻转（以 pivot 的 x 为轴，见 README）。锚点语义（各动作按自己的锚点对齐到 pivot）：脚点(底部中点)=idle/walk/crawl/fight/wave/shock/cry/possessed/hurt/down/kid/kneel/portrait/portrait_shock；脚点(自定义点)=float/dodge/guard/kick。portrait* 动作是说话头像（32×32 半身）：图集里放在最后几行（按底部中点对齐，只是为了同格对齐，不代表脚点），同时逐帧导出到“头像”文件夹，见 expressions；多数 frame0=闭嘴/静态、frame1=说话/加强（具体见各自 desc），原引擎对话框打字时以 8fps 来回切换。fps 取自源码 define(fps=…) 的建议播放速度（没给的用 6），场景里实际播放速率不统一；kind（loop/oneshot/static）是按帧描述和场景用法人工标注的。
